segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, yeah, thanks for making time. I wanted to confirm the renewal and the small expansion for Northpoint before we send the order form over.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure. We’re at 42 seats today, and I think we need 50 starting February 1. Finance asked me to keep the invoice annual if possible.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, annual billing works. For 50 seats on the team plan, the total is $37,500 for the year, covering February 1, 2026 through January 31, 2027.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Does that include the onboarding session for the eight new users?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: It does. One 90-minute admin session and one end-user session, both remote. We can put those the week of February 3 if that lines up with your go-live.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That’s good. We’re targeting February 10 for everyone to be live. Also, can the PO number be on the first invoice? It’ll be PO-41872.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, PO-41872 on the invoice. And just to verify, billing contact is still Martin Lee at invoices at northpoint dot com?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Correct. Legal contact is me. No redlines expected unless you changed the data processing terms.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: No changes there. Same terms as last year, plus the seat count update and the February 1 start date. I’ll send the order form this afternoon for signature.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Send it to me and copy Martin. If it matches what we discussed, I can sign by Friday.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. Once it’s signed, we’ll lock the February 4 admin training and February 6 user training. I’ll include those dates in the confirmation email.
